cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, time, itertools, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from validate import validate
from adaptive2 import run_one

def scenario(name, links, parts, dem, period, env):
    n=max(max(u,v) for u,v,_ in links)+1
    cmds=[{"op":"load","n":n,"links":[[u,v,c] for u,v,c in links],"bookings":[]}]
    for i,(p,d) in enumerate(zip(parts,dem)):
        cmds.append({"op":"prepare","id":f"p{i}","owner":"o","window":[0,period*10],"period":period,
                     "participants":[[v,d] for v in p],"envelope":env,"rev":i})
    return cmds

def go(name, links, parts, dem, period, env):
    cmds=scenario(name, links, parts, dem, period, env)
    t0=time.time(); reps=run_one(cmds); dt=time.time()-t0
    problems=[]; validate(cmds,reps,problems)
    r=reps[-1]
    if r.get('status')=='prepared':
        print(f"{name}: prepared trees={len(r['plan']['trees'])} routes={len(r['plan']['routes'])} recipes={len(r['plan']['recipes'])} {dt:.2f}s {problems}")
    else:
        print(f"{name}: {r.get('status')}/{r.get('kind','')} {str(r.get('cut'))[:60]} {dt:.2f}s {problems}")

go("cycle4", [(0,1,2),(1,3,1),(3,2,2),(2,0,1)], [[0,1,2,3]], [1], 10, [[0,1],[1,1],[2,1],[3,1]])
go("star", [(0,1,2),(0,2,2),(0,3,2)], [[0,1,2,3]], [1], 10, [[0,1],[1,1],[2,1]])
go("star-small", [(0,1,1),(0,2,1),(0,3,1)], [[0,1,2,3]], [1], 10, [[0,1],[1,1],[2,1]])
go("chain", [(0,5,1),(5,1,1),(1,6,1),(6,2,1),(2,7,1),(7,3,1)], [[0,3]], [2], 10, [[0,1],[1,1],[2,1],[3,1],[4,1],[5,1]])
go("wax", [(0,1,1),(1,2,1),(1,3,1)], [[0,2,3]], [1], 10, [[0,1],[1,1],[2,1]])
go("pair", [(0,2,5),(2,1,5)], [[0,1]], [4], 10, [[0,4],[1,4]])
# nonuniform demands
go("nonuni", [(0,1,10),(1,2,10),(2,3,10),(0,3,10),(0,2,10)], [[0,1,2,3]], [5,1,3,0], 10, [[0,5],[1,5],[2,5],[3,5],[4,5]])
# 8 participants on a grid-ish graph
links=[]
for i in range(8):
    links.append((i,(i+1)%8,4))
links.append((0,4,4)); links.append((2,6,4))
go("ring8", links, [list(range(8))], [2], 100, [[l,2] for l in range(len(links))])
PYEOF
